The proposed solution fails to consider the extreme conditions of a 350 kW depot fast charge, which is far beyond the typical operating conditions of most electric vehicles, and the resulting thermal and electrical stresses on the battery pack, as discussed in [doi:10.1109/acpee56931.2023.10135597], which highlights the challenges of fast charging lithium titanate batteries.
